title: WrenSMP Modded
description: A modpack to be used on WrenSMP. Now on Modrinth for easy distribution!
body:
# WrenSMP Modded: Client Side Pack
This is the client side modpack intended for use on the WrenSMP server. Now published on Modrinth for easier distribution amongst WrenSMP players.

## Features
* Create 6.0: with Steam n' Rails, Big Cannons, Radars, and an electrical system.
* Estrogen!
* Ad Astra: Venture into space.
* Tinker's: Customise your tools, weapons, and armour to no end.
* TaCZ: Survival-friendly firearms progression.
* Various exploration-focused features, including but not limited to Yung's various mods, Geophilic, Serene Seasons, Biomes O' Plenty, changes to villagers and illagers, etc.
* Various quality-of-life features, including but not limited to JEI, Ponder for Tinker's, Tinker's Planner, various optimisation mods, a complete set of Masa's technical Minecraft utility mods, etc.
---

Contains modified (removed non-Create crafting recipes) [Create Armorer (CC 4.0)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/customization/tacz-create-armorer-koei) and unmodified [Suffuse GunSmoke (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/customization/suffuse-gunsmoke) gunpacks for TaCZ; also contains unmodified [TaCZ Ammo Query (MIT)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tacz-ammo-query), unmodified [Create: Ad Astra Compatibility (MIT)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-ad-astra-compatibility), and unmodified [WorldEdit (GNU GPLv3)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/worldedit) mods.

Contact the maintainer if you have issues regarding copyright.
